tagline.zh: 一行声明锁定盒子的宽高比:宽度变了高度自动跟上,配合 object-fit 决定图片在比例盒内裁切、留边还是拉伸——视频位、头像与防 CLS 卡片的地基。
tagline.en: One declaration locks a box's width-to-height ratio: change the width and the height follows; pair it with object-fit to decide whether images crop, letterbox or stretch inside — the foundation of video slots, avatars and CLS-proof cards.

origin.zh: 出自 CSS Box Sizing Module Level 4 的 aspect-ratio 属性:语法 aspect-ratio = auto || <ratio>,<ratio> = <number [0,∞]> [ / <number [0,∞]> ]?;斜杠后省略高度时按 1 处理;盒子的宽高至少一边为 auto 时比例才生效;replaced 元素(如 img)写 auto <ratio> 时,内容加载后回退到内在比例。MDN 标注 Baseline Widely available,2021-09 起各浏览器可用(本次会话直连 MDN aspect-ratio 页核对)。
origin.en: From the aspect-ratio property in CSS Box Sizing Module Level 4: syntax aspect-ratio = auto || <ratio>, <ratio> = <number [0,∞]> [ / <number [0,∞]> ]?; omitting the height after the slash treats it as 1; the ratio only applies when at least one of the box's sizes is auto; on replaced elements (like img) written as auto <ratio>, the intrinsic ratio takes over once content loads. MDN marks it Baseline Widely available, available across browsers since 2021-09 (verified against the MDN aspect-ratio page this session).

effect.zh: 盒子的首选宽高比(CSS 型 --ar-ratio,注入 aspect-ratio)。默认 16 / 9 为 MDN 官方示例值;1/1、4/3、3/2、21/9、9/16 为社区常见内容比例(头像方形、胶片 3:2、高清视频 16:9、带幕/竖屏短视频),未证实为任何规范推荐——按内容形态自选。
effect.en: The box's preferred width/height ratio (CSS-type --ar-ratio feeding aspect-ratio). The 16 / 9 default is an MDN official example value; 1/1, 4/3, 3/2, 21/9 and 9/16 are common content ratios in the community (square avatars, 3:2 film, 16:9 HD video, ultrawide/vertical shorts), unverified as any spec recommendation — pick by content shape.

effect.zh: 子 img 的 object-fit(CSS 型 --ar-fit;object-fit 必须写在图片元素上,不是容器上——调研 12§1)。demo 的样图内在比例为 4:3,与默认 16:9 比例盒不同,三档差异一目了然:cover 裁切、contain 留边、fill 压扁。
effect.en: The child img's object-fit (CSS-type --ar-fit; object-fit must sit on the image element, not the container — research 12 §1). The demo's sample image has an intrinsic 4:3 ratio, deliberately different from the default 16:9 box, so the three grades are unmistakable: cover crops, contain letterboxes, fill squashes.

effect.zh: 比例盒的宽度(CSS 型 --ar-width;高度留 auto 由比例推导——至少一边为 auto 比例才生效,MDN)。默认 320px 为演示基准值,未证实;MDN 官方示例用固定 width 100px + height auto 演示同一机制。拖动观察实测高度读数如何跟随比例换算。
effect.en: The ratio box's width (CSS-type --ar-width; height stays auto and is derived from the ratio — the ratio only applies with at least one auto size, per MDN). Default 320px is a demo baseline, unverified; MDN's official example uses a fixed 100px width + auto height for the same mechanism. Drag it and watch the measured height track the ratio math.

note.zh: aspect-ratio 为 Baseline Widely available,2021-09 起各浏览器可用(Chrome 88 / Firefox 89 / Safari 15 量级,本次会话直连 MDN 页核对到 Baseline 日期;逐家版本号 MDN 页正文未列,以 caniuse 为准)。object-fit 为更早的广泛可用能力(调研 12§1 记其在 picture 子 img 上的配合约束)。
note.en: aspect-ratio is Baseline Widely available, working across browsers since 2021-09 (Chrome 88 / Firefox 89 / Safari 15 ballpark — the Baseline date verified on the MDN page this session; per-browser version numbers are not listed in the MDN body, defer to caniuse). object-fit is an older, widely available capability (research 12 §1 records its pairing constraint on picture's child img).

fallback.zh: 老浏览器的等价写法是 padding-top 百分比技巧(伪元素或 ::before 用 padding-top: 56.25% 撑出 16:9,内容绝对定位其上)——社区通用做法,未证实为官方推荐;现代写法失败时盒子退化为内容自然高度,布局不破。img 永远补 width/height 属性:加载前就占位,这本身即 CLS 防线(MDN「preventing jank」指南主题)。
fallback.en: The legacy equivalent is the padding-top percentage hack (a pseudo-element with padding-top: 56.25% creates 16:9, content absolutely positioned over it) — a common community practice, unverified as an official recommendation; if the modern property is unsupported the box degrades to natural content height without breaking layout. Always add width/height attributes to img so space is reserved before load — itself a CLS defense (the topic of MDN's 'preventing jank' guide).

use.zh: 视频/嵌入位:16:9 槽位先占住,iframe 加载完不跳版
use.en: Video/embed slots: reserve a 16:9 stage so iframes never shift the page

use.zh: 头像与缩略图:1:1 比例盒 + object-fit: cover 裁齐任何上传图
use.en: Avatars and thumbnails: a 1:1 box + object-fit: cover normalizes any upload

use.zh: 瀑布流/卡片栅格的占位:加载前按目标比例撑高,消灭 CLS
use.en: Grid/masonry placeholders: pre-load sizing in the target ratio kills CLS

use.zh: 响应式图片配合:img 写 width/height 属性 + CSS 约束一边,浏览器按内在比例推导另一边(调研 12§1 片段的 width=1200 height=675)
use.en: Paired with responsive images: img width/height attributes + CSS constraining one axis, the browser derives the other from the intrinsic ratio (the width=1200 height=675 pair in research 12 §1)

avoid.zh: 盒子的宽高都写死——比例无 auto 边可作用,声明被忽略(MDN 明确条件)
avoid.en: Hard-coding both width and height — no auto axis means the ratio is ignored (explicit MDN condition)

avoid.zh: 用比例盒装不定长文本——文本溢出比例框;比例适合 replaced 内容,正文让自然高度说话
avoid.en: Ratio boxes around variable-length text — text overflows the frame; ratios suit replaced content, let body copy keep natural height

avoid.zh: 对 img 只写 CSS 比例不写 width/height 属性——加载前无法占位,CLS 回来
avoid.en: CSS ratio on img without width/height attributes — nothing reserves space pre-load, CLS returns

avoid.zh: 21:9 一类极端比例放正文插图——移动端高度过小,内容不可读
avoid.en: Extreme ratios like 21:9 for body illustrations — too short on mobile to read

a11y.zh: 比例盒只锁几何不锁内容:object-fit: cover 裁掉的边缘可能包含关键图像信息,重要图配足 alt 并优先 contain 或调整 ratio;img 的 width/height 属性防止加载跳版(WCAG 布局可预期性);装饰性样图 alt="";demo 读数为实时真实测量,不依赖颜色传达状态。
a11y.en: A ratio box locks geometry, not content: edges cropped away by object-fit: cover may carry key image information — pair important images with sufficient alt text and prefer contain or a different ratio; img width/height attributes prevent load-time layout jumps (predictable layout per WCAG); decorative samples get alt=""; the demo's readouts are live, real measurements, never color-only signals.

goal.zh: 复刻一个比例锁定卡位:宽度随栅格流动、高度由 aspect-ratio 推导,内置图片用 object-fit: cover 裁切填满,加载前后零布局偏移。
goal.en: Replicate a ratio-locked card slot: width flows with the grid, height derived by aspect-ratio, the embedded image fills via object-fit: cover, zero layout shift before and after load.

acceptance.zh: aspect-ratio 值严格使用参数快照(如 16 / 9);宽度参数照抄,高度保持 auto
acceptance.en: The aspect-ratio value uses the exact parameter snapshot (e.g. 16 / 9); the width parameter verbatim, height left auto

acceptance.zh: object-fit 写在内层 img 元素上,不是容器上
acceptance.en: object-fit sits on the inner img element, not the container

acceptance.zh: img 同时携带 width/height 属性占位,防加载 CLS
acceptance.en: The img carries width/height attributes so pre-load space is reserved (no CLS)

acceptance.zh: 比例盒宽度至少一边为 auto——不得把宽高同时写死
acceptance.en: At least one of the ratio box's axes stays auto — never hard-code both width and height

acceptance.zh: 栅格变化时高度随比例自动换算,不出现跳变或溢出
acceptance.en: As the grid changes, height tracks the ratio automatically with no jumps or overflow
